vibe.verdict: Gets the chicken jockey and Lava Chicken right, but plays the rest as a generic campfire canteen and skips Steve's best lines.
missing: Dennis the dog, taken by Malgosha in the Nether
Garrett's hunt for an Atari Cosmos (the storage auction)
Chuggy the potato chip mascot (Chuglass, Henry's jetpack)
The Great Hog blown up by creepers (the minecart escape)
ideas: Swap 'Sweet berry and lime soda' for 'Lava Chicken soda', orange and lime, so the Steve song has a drink to match.
Swap the 'Mine at your own risk' badge for 'Flint and steel!', Steve's catchphrase.
Swap 'Melon block skewers with mint sugar' for 'Chuggy chips and dip', after the Chuglass potato chip mascot.
Swap the golden apples joke on 'Golden carrots with honey butter' for a Dennis note: the dog who carried the Orb home wants a treat.
